name: Classic Spaghetti Carbonara
author: u1
description: Creamy Roman pasta made with eggs, pecorino, and crispy guanciale.
instructions: Boil the spaghetti in salted water until al dente, reserving 1 cup of pasta water. Fry the guanciale until crisp. Whisk eggs, pecorino, and pepper together. Toss hot pasta with the guanciale, remove from heat, then stir in the egg mixture, adding pasta water as needed until creamy. Serve immediately.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
author: u3
description: Tender marinated chicken in a spiced tomato cream sauce.
instructions: Marinate the chicken in yogurt, half the garam masala, ginger, and garlic for at least 1 hour. Sear the chicken in oil until browned, then set aside. Saute the onion until soft, add the remaining spices and tomatoes, and simmer for 15 minutes. Stir in the cream and chicken and cook for 10 more minutes. Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice or naan.

name: Vegan Chickpea Salad Sandwich
author: u3
description: A no-cook, protein-packed take on classic chicken salad.
instructions: Roughly mash the chickpeas in a bowl, leaving some texture. Mix in the mayonnaise, mustard, celery, onion, and lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper. Spread onto bread and assemble sandwiches.

name: Fluffy Buttermilk Pancakes
author: u4
description: Light, tall pancakes perfect for weekend mornings.
instructions: Whisk the dry ingredients together in a large bowl. In another bowl, combine buttermilk, eggs, and melted butter. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry and stir until just combined; a few lumps are fine. Cook 1/4 cup scoops on a medium-hot greased griddle until bubbles form, then flip and cook until golden.

name: Beef Tacos
author: u2
instructions: Brown the ground beef in a skillet and drain the excess fat. Add the taco seasoning and a splash of water, then simmer for 5 minutes. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan. Fill with beef and top with lettuce, tomatoes, cheese, and sour cream. Serve with lime wedges.

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp
author: u1
description: Ready in 15 minutes with just a handful of ingredients.
instructions: Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the garlic and red pepper flakes and cook for 30 seconds. Add the shrimp and cook 2 minutes per side until pink. Pour in the wine and lemon juice and simmer for 1 minute. Stir in the parsley and serve.

name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
author: u4
description: Chewy in the middle with crisp, golden edges.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190C (375F). Whisk the flour, baking soda, and salt together. Cream the butter with both sugars until fluffy, then beat in the eggs and vanilla. Gradually mix in the dry ingredients, then fold in the chocolate chips. Drop rounded tablespoons onto lined baking sheets and bake 9 to 11 minutes until golden.

name: Veggie Stir-Fry with Tofu
author: u3
description: A colorful weeknight stir-fry with crispy tofu.
instructions: Toss the tofu with cornstarch and pan-fry in sesame oil until crisp, then set aside. Stir-fry the garlic and vegetables over high heat for 4 to 5 minutes. Add the tamari and maple syrup, return the tofu to the pan, and toss to coat. Serve over rice.

name: Hearty Beef Chili
author: u2
description: A thick, slow-simmered chili that tastes even better the next day.
instructions: Brown the beef with the onion in a large pot, then add the garlic and spices and cook for 1 minute. Stir in the tomatoes, beans, and broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer uncovered for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally. Adjust seasoning and serve with toppings of your choice.

name: Greek Salad
author: u1
instructions: Combine the tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, and olives in a large bowl. Whisk the olive oil, vinegar, and oregano together and pour over the salad. Toss gently, top with the feta, and serve.
